title: Neko header
description: A see-through bar floating over the page: a charcoal squircle logo on the left, three quiet links centred, a blue 'book' button on the right. The centre links fade and lift away over the first 450px of scrolling, leaving just the logo and the button. On phones: the logo and a two-line menu button that opens a full-screen menu.
notes: takes no height: it sits on top of the first section (the hero starts at the top of the page under it)
the nav fade is CSS scroll-driven; the phone menu needs JavaScript
